note: 1,200 plans for 300 requests on plot sizes the model never saw (3 to 34 marla), each with a washroom count and a bigger-room choice. Baseline: the rule-based generator, one try. Every one of the 292 requests the form can make (3 marla to 60x110) gets a valid plan from the model. The model is pre-trained on synthetic plans and fine-tuned on real Pakistani plans read by a vision model: on hand-checked real plans it never saw, perplexity fell from 299 to 58.
